items.prompt: A copy editor reviews sentences from four unrelated notices. Which sentence has correct present-tense subject-verb agreement in standard written American English?

choices.A: Everyone on the hiking trails have a map.
choices.B: Someone beside the storage lockers are waiting for a key.
choices.C: Nobody among the volunteers knows the new route.
choices.D: Anybody with the spare batteries need to sign the sheet.

items.prompt: Which complete sentence could be printed without changing its present-tense subject-verb agreement in standard written American English?

choices.A: The compass and the map is on the table.
choices.B: The kettle and the toaster work on the same outlet.
choices.C: The bicycle and the helmet belongs in the shed.
choices.D: The violin and the cello has new cases.
